#
# NOT to be regenerated from the Rust output. Capture only from the C tools:
#   cd rust/sai && TL_FRAMES_CAPTURE=/abs/path/body.txt cargo test -p tl-frames --features cli \
#     --test differential -- --test-threads=1 differential_in_a_user_namespace
#   (runs the 70 scenarios of tests/differential.rs under `unshare -rn`; the C tool's run of each is written
#   to body.txt, in key order; this file is that body under this header). The C run was captured twice:
#   byte-identical. Command lines and inputs are the scenarios in tests/differential.rs (stored there: the
#   scenario table, the sflow chip emulator, the sample frames, the canned psample family); nothing else is input.
#
# Record per scenario ("@@ <tool>/<label>"): the tool's exit status, its masked stdout and stderr (Rust-escaped
# on one line each: times, rates and the program path are masked as the live comparison masks them; psample
# `iif=<n>(` is masked because the interface index depends on which scenario group made its veth first), the
# number of frames captured on the veth peer, and each frame as hex ("f <hex>"; run ids masked to zero where the
# live test masks them, IPv6 UDP checksums zeroed after being verified). veth ends get fixed MACs (mac_of in the
# test) so source MACs are stable. Frames are stored in full (no digest): the file is about 230 KB.
#
# The tests: differential_in_a_user_namespace (inner scenarios) compares the live C tool to this golden ("live ==
# golden" proof, when the C sources exist) and the Rust tool to it (also without the C sources); golden_shape and
# golden_negative_control check the golden itself.
